note: A source file deleted or renamed in watch mode or the dev server no longer leaves its styles behind: its `globalCss`, its own stylesheet and the class names handed out in it are dropped, and it leaves the bucket it collapsed into. The engine gains `removeFile(filename)` (native and WASM), which Vite calls on a `delete` watch change, webpack and Rsbuild on the removed files of a watch run (webpack watch mode also saves the pruned state), and the Next.js Turbopack coordinator when an edited file is extracted again. Atoms in a stylesheet other files share stay, as nothing records which file added them; they style nothing once no module uses them
